statBlock.name: Stirge
statBlock.description: A flying blood feeder that latches onto its prey.

sections.Actions: Proboscis. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. The stirge deals 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage on a hit and attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge cannot make Proboscis attacks. The target takes 5 (2d4) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the stirge's turns. The stirge can spend 5 ft. of movement to detach. The target or a creature within 5 ft. of it can also use an action to detach the stirge.
sections.Habitats: Desert, forest, grassland, hill, mountain, swamp, underdark, urban.

statBlock.name: Swarm of Crawling Claws
statBlock.classification: Medium swarm of Tiny undead, neutral evil
statBlock.description: A mass of animated severed hands that pulls down creatures within reach.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Incapacitated, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned.
sections.Traits: Swarm. The swarm and other creatures can share spaces. It fits through openings large enough for a Tiny creature and cannot regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
sections.Actions: Swarm of Grasping Hands. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 20 (4d8 + 2) Necrotic damage, or 11 (2d8 + 2) Necrotic damage while the swarm is Bloodied. A Medium or smaller creature hit by this attack also falls Prone.

statBlock.name: Swarm of Stirges
statBlock.classification: Medium swarm of Tiny monstrosities, unaligned
statBlock.description: A cloud of blood feeders that can pin a creature caught in their midst.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned.
sections.Traits: Swarm. The swarm and other creatures can share spaces. It fits through openings large enough for a Tiny creature and cannot regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
sections.Actions: Swarm of Proboscises. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) Piercing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage while the swarm is Bloodied. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature in the swarm's space, it is also Grappled (escape DC 13). The target takes 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage at the end of each of its turns until the grapple ends.
sections.Habitats: Desert, forest, grassland, hill, mountain, swamp, underdark, urban.

statBlock.name: Thri-kreen Marauder
statBlock.description: A fast-moving thri-kreen that fights with a gythka and thrown chatkcha.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Gythka and Chatkcha.
Gythka. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.
Chatkcha. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Leap. Spend 5 ft. of movement to jump up to 15 ft.

statBlock.name: Thri-kreen Psion
statBlock.description: A thri-kreen that hovers and attacks with psychic force.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Psionic Lance attacks.
Psionic Lance. Melee or ranged attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. A hit deals 18 (4d6 + 4) Psychic damage.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell without components, using Intelligence (spell save DC 15). At will, Mage Hand creates an Invisible hand. Detect Thoughts, Sending, and Synaptic Static are each available once per day.

statBlock.name: Vampire Familiar
statBlock.classification: Small or Medium humanoid, neutral evil
statBlock.description: A humanoid servant whose vampire master can see through its eyes.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, except when the source is its vampire master.
sections.Traits: Vampiric Connection. While the familiar and its vampire master share a plane, the master can contact it telepathically and perceive through the familiar's senses.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Umbral Dagger attacks.
Umbral Dagger. Melee or ranged attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) Necrotic damage. A target this attack reduces to 0 Hit Points becomes Stable and is Poisoned for 1 hour. The target is Paralyzed while Poisoned in this way.
sections.Bonus actions: Deathless Agility. Take the Dash or Disengage action.

statBlock.name: Violet Fungus Necrohulk
statBlock.description: An enormous fungal creature that seizes prey and grafts it to its own body.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rotting Slam attacks.
Rotting Slam. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.
Spore Bomb (Recharge 5–6). Center a 20-ft.-radius Sphere on a point the necrohulk can see within 60 ft. Each creature in the Sphere makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 28 (8d6) Necrotic damage and is Poisoned until the start of the necrohulk's next turn. It cannot regain Hit Points while Poisoned in this way. On a success, it takes half damage only.
sections.Bonus actions: Absorb Body. Choose one Small or Medium creature the necrohulk can see within 5 ft. The target makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, the necrohulk pulls the target into its space and grafts it to its body. It can have only one target grafted at a time. The grafted target is Restrained, has Disadvantage on Constitution saves, and moves with the necrohulk. If the grafted target dies, its body is destroyed and the necrohulk regains 10 Hit Points. The target or a creature within 5 ft. of the necrohulk can use an action to make a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the target is freed and moves to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the necrohulk.

statBlock.name: Warrior Commander
statBlock.description: An experienced officer who opens gaps for allies and counters attacks that come close.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Greatsword and Longbow.
Greatsword. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 19 (4d6 + 5) Slashing damage. The commander also chooses one effect. Sap gives the target Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of the commander's next turn. Maneuver lets one ally who can see or hear the commander use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
Longbow. Ranged attack, +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft. A hit deals 18 (3d8 + 5) Piercing damage and reduces the target's Speed by 10 ft. until the end of the target's next turn.
sections.Bonus actions: Tactical Charge. Move up to half the commander's Speed straight toward a visible enemy without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
sections.Reactions: Counterattack. When an attack roll hits the commander, it adds 4 to its AC against that attack, potentially making the attack miss. If it misses, the commander can make one Greatsword or Longbow attack against the attacker.
